rendered: In this paper, BA means 4-mercaptophenylboronic acid[1]. The introduction defines it as 4-mercaptophenyl-boronic acid (4-MPBA, BA)[2]. The authors attach it to positively charged L-type intrinsically helical gold nanorods (L-HGNRs), which gives the BA@L-HGNRs recognition probe. BA binds the probe to bacteria through boronic acid–cis-diol[3] interactions, working together with electrostatic attraction.
